# `world/WorldSchema.js`

> **Source:** `engine/world/WorldSchema.js`

WorldSchema.js - Unified JSON Schema for World Generation Defines consistent data structures for: - Biome types and properties - Climate parameters - Terrain generation settings - Chunk/zone configurations - Weather and time systems All world generation code should use these schemas for consistency.

## Functions

### `getBiomeTypeId(biomeName)`

Get biome type ID from name

### `getBiomeTypeName(biomeId)`

Get biome type name from ID

### `validateTerrain(config)`

Validate terrain config

### `validateWeather(config)`

Validate weather config

### `validateWorldConfig(config)`

Validate world config

### `createDefaultTerrain()`

Create default terrain config

### `createDefaultWeather()`

Create default weather

### `createDefaultWorldConfig(seed = Date.now()`

Create default world config

### `createClimateFromPosition(latitude, altitude, oceanDistance)`

Create climate from biome position

### `getBiomeFromClimate(climate)`

Get biome from climate

### `getWeatherPreset(typeName)`

Get weather preset

### `getTimePhase(hour)`

Get time phase for hour

## Constants

- `BIOME_TYPES` — Biome type definitions
- `CLIMATE_PARAMS` — Climate parameter ranges (0-1)
- `CLIMATE_SCHEMA` — Climate schema for biome selection
- `BIOME_SCHEMA` — Biome definition schema
- `NOISE_SCHEMA` — Noise parameters schema
- `EROSION_TYPES` — Erosion types
- `TERRAIN_SCHEMA` — Terrain generation schema
- `CHUNK_SIZES` — Chunk sizes
- `ZONE_TYPES` — Zone types for streaming
- `CHUNK_STREAMING_SCHEMA` — Chunk streaming schema
- `WEATHER_TYPES` — Weather types
- `WEATHER_SCHEMA` — Weather schema
- `TIME_PHASES` — Time of day phases
- `WORLD_TIME_SCHEMA` — World time schema
- `WORLD_CONFIG_SCHEMA` — Complete world configuration

## Notes & Examples

### World Streaming & Scenes

The world system manages scene graphs, asset streaming, and level transitions. Scenes are entity hierarchies with spatial indexing (BVH) for fast culling and raycasts. Worlds stream assets asynchronously with priority based on distance and visibility.

**Example: Scene graph and streaming**
```js
import { World } from 'engine/world/World.js';
import { Scene } from 'engine/scenes/Scene.js';
import { Entity } from 'engine/ecs/Entity.js';

const world = new World();
const scene = new Scene();
world.addScene(scene);

// Create hierarchy
const player = new Entity('Player');
const camera = new Entity('Camera');
const weapon = new Entity('Weapon');

player.addChild(camera);
camera.addChild(weapon);  // Weapon follows camera

scene.add(player);

// Stream in a level
await world.streamLevel('level1', {
  priority: 'high',
  bounds: player.boundingBox,
  onProgress: (pct) => console.log(`Loading: ${pct}%`)
});

// Spatial query: find entities in radius
const nearby = scene.querySphere(player.position, 50);
```
